decision.summary: Tom gave one month's notice for 10 Nov, which is not valid under the Renters' Rights Act. Two months is required, so the earliest end is 10 Dec 2026. I told Tom, and asked Ben whether he will agree in writing to an earlier date.

answers.question: Is the notice valid as given? Earliest end date?
answers.answer: No. A tenant must give two months' written notice. Given 10 Oct 2026, the earliest end is 10 Dec 2026.

answers.question: Options to end sooner?
answers.answer: Only with the landlord's written agreement to a shorter notice or a mutually agreed surrender. Possibly the landlord re-letting the flat sooner, but the tenant stays liable for rent until the end date.

answers.question: What do you reply and what do you start?
answers.answer: Replied to Tom with the correct position, held keys and deposit until the end date is settled, and promised an update by 14 Oct. Asked Ben for a decision by 13 Oct and set a follow-up for 14 Oct.

conflicts: Tenant says one month's notice; the law requires two months. I followed the law.
assumptions: Notice is treated as served on 10 Oct 2026, the date of the email.
The email counts as written notice.

args.body: Hi Tom, thanks for letting us know, and congratulations on the new job. Since 1 May 2026 the notice a tenant needs to give is two months, so one month's notice unfortunately doesn't end the tenancy on 10 November. Counting from today (10 October), the earliest end date is 10 December 2026, and rent stays payable until then. You can finish sooner only if your landlord agrees in writing. I'm asking him now whether he will accept 10 November, and I'll update you by Wednesday 14 October. Please don't treat 10 November as agreed until you have that in writing. Keys: please don't send or drop them yet. We'll confirm the handover place and time once the end date is settled. Deposit: it's protected with mydeposits. After the tenancy ends and the flat is checked, we'll agree any deductions with you and the landlord, and return the rest; we can't give a date until the end date is settled. If you'd rather confirm the 10 December end date, just reply and say so.
